name: Breethe
reason: Health restore, re-read 12 Nov 2026 under the new rule: still out. breethe.com (robots allows) leads as an 'all-in-one mental wellness app' ('Feel better. Sleep better.'), and its home page, the only page that presents the app itself, features user quotes that it 'did more for my insomnia than sleeping pills' and is 'like having a therapist', plus another on chronic insomnia; that is the 'equal to medication / better than therapy' line, and the app listing can't leave its own landing page out. Its About page also leads with AI coaches 'with psychologist input' and hypnotherapy as a main content type, and names a 'Self-Care During the Coronavirus' track. Contacts exist (support@breethe.com, pr@breethe.com); founder Lynne Goldberg is already listed (lynne-goldberg). Owner may revisit if testimonials are judged not to be the brand's own claims. Previous record (same path, 9 Nov 2026) said condition-led; restore lead rank 3004.
